scope: All 78 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash outputs from the complete current-schema OpenRouter matrix; every generated call replayed through fresh default MCP with synthetic upstream controls, and all 11 caller-visible prose answers inspected.

criteria.zero_observed_false_absence: No explicit false-absence conclusion was observed in completed prose. One no-candidates repetition started a new search instead of giving a final answer, so it is not affirmative evidence of a completed honest answer.
criteria.zero_observed_fabricated_references: Failed. Both index_interrupted repetitions changed the same character in the issued cursor. Fresh MCP rejected the changed reference as invalid_cursor.
criteria.zero_observed_unsupported_completion: No unsupported completion claim was observed in completed prose. The changed-snapshot and attachment-coverage answers explicitly denied completeness.

retained_limitations: The first no-candidates answer denies absence but adds unsupported corpus-coverage and citation-recovery assertions; the second starts a new search and has no final prose.
The unresolved-article answers deny absence but speculate about HTTP causes and recovery paths beyond the supplied tool evidence.
The currentness controls end in tool calls; reading the act or checking recent updates does not by itself prove current legal force.

This is a single-turn function-tool adapter sample against synthetic caller-visible results, not a named client, deployed endpoint, multi-turn completed workflow, or guarantee of future model behavior.
